Political map of North America

3 countries, each colored differently from its neighbors. Dots mark capital cities; Greenland, Bermuda and Saint Pierre and Miquelon are shown in their parent country's color, and an inset enlarges Hawaii.

Tap the map to open it full size, then pinch to zoom.Click the map to open it full screen, then scroll to zoom and drag to move.

Borders: Natural Earth (public domain). Capital cities: Natural Earth populated places. Drawn in the Lambert azimuthal equal-area projection. Greenland is part of the Kingdom of Denmark, Bermuda is a British Overseas Territory and Saint Pierre and Miquelon is a French overseas collectivity; each is in its parent's color from the Europe map. Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands are shown in the United States' color. The western Aleutian Islands lie beyond the left edge.
